thread:
liam: Hey finance — just got back from a trip and the rental car charge on the corpcard has a few opaque line items. The vendor (EuRoDrive) posted a single total and then later a separate 'Concession Recovery Charge' and a toll batch. My receipt PDF only shows total = €312.50 and a short merchant note. I need an itemized invoice for VAT reclaim and for audit. What do you need from me to start a dispute or get the vendor invoice?

ava: Thanks for flagging, liam. Can you upload the PDF you have and paste the merchant transaction ID (on the card statement) here? We'll need that plus the rental agreement if possible. Also tell us whether you paid fuel or tolls at the counter vs authorizations.

liam: Uploaded the two files to the expense (EXP-2025-089). Card txn id: EURODRIVE*1234567890. The receipt text is just: "EURODRIVE    312.50 EUR CREDIT CARD" and the bank shows a second line: "CONCESSION RECOVERY 42.00 EUR". I didn't get a detailed folio. I declined roadside insurance at pickup. I did accept the tolls to be charged to the card (I thought they'd be itemized).

ava: Got it. For our VAT reclaim and dispute we need: 1) vendor itemized invoice showing base rental, VAT, tolls, and any concession fees; 2) rental agreement or folio showing what was signed at pickup; 3) short note from you confirming you declined optional insurances. If the vendor won't provide an itemized invoice we can open a card dispute for the concession charge but disputes can take 45+ days.

maya: +1 from manager — please proceed with vendor request first, liam. If they stall, escalate to dispute. Also confirm whether this was business-only mileage and if any personal days on the booking.

liam: Confirmed business-only. No personal days. I'll email the vendor now. Drafted this to send: ```Hello EuRoDrive accounts,

Can you please provide an itemized invoice for reservation #R-987654 showing the breakdown of base rental, VAT, tolls, and any concession/recovery fees? Our finance team requires a VAT-compliant invoice to process reimbursement and VAT reclaim for a corporate charge made on our card on 2025-06-12 (txn id EURODRIVE*1234567890).

Thanks,
Liam
Redwood Inference``` Does that look okay to send?

ava: Perfect — add the expense id EXP-2025-089 in the subject line and cc finance@redwood.ai. Also include a scanned copy of the rental agreement. If they respond with only a receipt, ask for a folio or proforma showing VAT breakdown.

liam: Sent email, subject: "EXP-2025-089 — Request for itemized invoice R-987654". They replied auto-receipt: "Your inquiry has been received, we will respond within 5 business days."

expensebot: Expense EXP-2025-089 moved to status: vendor-requested (automated). Please attach any follow-ups to the expense thread.

ava: Thanks — we'll track. If no vendor response after 5bd, escalate to a dispute with the card provider. I'll start a tentative dispute playbook and flag the payments team.

liam: One more question — the card shows "concession recovery" as a separate line. Is that typically reimbursable?

maya: If the fee is a mandatory government or operator toll it's reimbursable. If it's an optional vendor surcharge (e.g., airport concession recovery for using an offsite lot) we usually don't reimburse without prior approval. Put a short note in the expense about what the agent told you at pickup.

liam: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ava: I'll update once finance hears back from the vendor or we start the dispute. Leaving a quick checklist here:
- Receipt PDF (attached)
- Bank txn id (provided)
- Rental agreement (requested)
- Vendor itemized invoice (requested)
- Manager approval for dispute (maya approved)

liam: Checklist complete except itemized invoice, will follow up if no response in 5bd.
